### Install
1. Install Claude Code and sign in: `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`, then `claude auth login`
2. Download **Shellby-Setup-x.y.z.exe** below (or the portable exe). On a Mac: **Shellby-x.y.z-arm64.dmg** for Apple silicon, **Shellby-x.y.z-x64.dmg** for Intel, then drag him to Applications

Existing installs update themselves.

> Builds are code-signed by **Jacob Barford**. If Windows SmartScreen still appears (it can for new releases), check the publisher and click **More info → Run anyway**. The Mac build isn't signed by Apple yet: the first time, allow it in **System Settings › Privacy & Security › Open Anyway**, and download new versions from here. These files are built by GitHub Actions from this tag.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/x-salmon/shellby/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for what's new.
